missions.title: Assist the Mercenaries
missions.description: We provided support and cover for an elite squad in regaining full control over Area S09. Sadly we still never found out who they were in the end.

missions.title: Cut Off Reinforcement
missions.description: We received prior information about the local Ringleader for this operation, and we finally got in touch with M16A1, the last member of the AR Team. All is going well.

missions.title: Break Through Enemy Lines
missions.description: "Intruder" showed itself and taunted us, but we had already fought our way into its territory.

missions.title: Search for Companions
missions.description: As we were heading deeper into enemy territory, we suddenly received an order to search for that elite squad from before. We seem to have lost track of them...

missions.title: Locate the Coordinates
missions.description: That elusive squad seemes to be out of danger and has even left us coordinates denoting the weak spots in the Sangvis base's defense. That's how we managed to get in.

missions.title: Eradicate the Disturbance
missions.description: Control over Area S09 is fully restored, and M16A1 is also back with us. But she has brought unsettling news... What exactly is Plan "Parapluie"?

missions.title: Reminiscing I
missions.description: While carrying out an investigation suggested by M4A1, we stumbled across a cryptic audio file that seems to have come from a T-Doll's neural cloud.

missions.title: Reminiscing II
missions.description: SOP-II joined us in the investigation and confirmed the rumors about her... Innocence doesn't necessarily have to be cute, though she's still pretty cute as she is.

missions.title: Reminiscing III
missions.description: AR-15 also helped, then gave M4A1 a lecture. She's always so oblique...but nonetheless very reliable.

missions.title: Reminiscing IV
missions.description: The AR Team listened to the combined audio recordings and decrypted them with my help. The file they ended up getting was...

missions.title: One-Week Teammates I
missions.description: RO's Report: I am back at Grifon, leading an ad-hoc squad in search for Document 36. After many days of stagnation, we are finally making some headway.

missions.title: One-Week Teammates II
missions.description: RO's Report: This is the only human left who knows about Document 36. We must find him ASAP! Come on, RO, you can do it!

missions.title: One-Week Teammates III
missions.description: RO's Report: Sangvis Ferri destroyed the city with artillery, and the status of my teammates is unclear. I don't want to lose any more friends. I have to do something…

missions.title: One-Week Teammates IV
missions.description: RO's Report: Mission accomplished. I hope we will have all the fun we can tonight...as I shall be heading over to the AR Team tomorrow to take over from HER.
